description: Fix critical security and correctness issues identified in semantic review
steps: Fix storage path traversal in src/stdlib_storage.c - reject keys containing '..' or starting with '/'
Fix GC rooting in compress.encode_response in src/stdlib_compress.c - root ObjString temporaries before allocating more
Fix GC rooting in http_client extract_config in src/stdlib_http_client.c - root ObjString temporaries
Fix sanitize attribute value escaping in src/stdlib_sanitize.c - HTML-escape attribute values
Fix CSP form_action OOB read in src/stdlib_csp.c - remove the dead len==10 branch
Fix jobs handler closures not GC-rooted in src/stdlib_jobs.c - call vm_pin on closures when registering
acceptance_criteria: Storage rejects keys containing '..' or starting with '/'
GC roots are properly managed in compress.encode_response
GC roots are properly managed in http_client extract_config
Attribute values are HTML-escaped in sanitize output
CSP has no OOB read for form_action
Job handler closures are pinned for GC
